answer: Let rewards vest over 30 days and trace where they go. If several accounts funnel coins to one shared vertex in the transfer graph, treat them as one operator: unvested rewards for the whole cluster are clawed back, and the ripple spreads to every account that fed that hub. A Sybil farm needs a cash-out haven, but any common wallet exposes it, so the attacker must keep each fake fully separate for a month, paying setup and upkeep per identity with no way to pool income.
